SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water Pollution.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Pollution.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Pollution.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Pollution.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Classification of Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Classification of Plants.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Classification of Plants.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Classification of Plants.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Classification of Plants.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Heat transfer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Classification of Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Human Breathing System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — 100 °C

3. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.

4. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

5. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy.

6. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Pollution.

7. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Classification of Plants.

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.

9. A — Producers

10. B — Glucose and oxygen

11. C — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .
